documents.title: The Voyager Royale: VIP luxury on wheels (Force Urbania)
documents.content: Features, standard configuration and base price, priced options, terms.

documents.title: Voyager VIP on Force Urbania, WB 4400 mm
documents.content: Two dimensioned top-view layouts (inches), seat product sheet, sofa, washroom, pantry, entertainment, air suspension, awning, colour themes.

build_type: VIP seating van (executive transport), NOT a motor caravan. It has seats, a washroom and a pantry but no fixed sleeping accommodation in layout 1, so AIS-124 does not apply to it as built. The second layout adds a 1-person sofa-cum-bed.

measurements.note: From the dimensioned top views (Oct 2026 deck p.2–3). Drawings are schematic, dimensions in whole inches. Used in data/vehicles/force_urbania_4400wb.json as BUILDER_MEASURED.

aisle_between_recliners.note: Seated-passenger aisle between recliner pairs; inside the D-AISLE-MIN WARNING band (300–400 mm).

rear_sofa_cum_bed_depth.as_drawn: 36 in as a bed, 24 in as a sofa

features: Vetus electric WC (a fixed toilet: AIS-124 cl. 4.5.2(c) black-water storage applies)
50 L compressor fridge (25 L top-opening in the base configuration)

rear_air_suspension.product: BharatAutoSolution air suspension kit, installed at the rear
rear_air_suspension.compliance_note: A suspension change. Fine for this VIP van only if it meets the alteration rules that apply to it (not checked here). As part of a motor caravan conversion it breaches AIS-124 cl. 0.1: see rules.json C-NO-MECHANICAL-CHANGES examples.

awning.note: Shown on a Force Traveller T2 camper build, with a folding table and 4 chairs. Deployed it projects sideways: Rule 93(1)(B)(ii) and (3) apply while driving (stowed).

prices.note: Builder's published prices in the Aug 2026 deck. Conversion only: the customer supplies the base vehicle (50 % advance 'with the vehicle'). GST 18 % extra. Excludes logistics and vehicle registration. Quotation validity 60 days, so these figures lapsed around Oct 2026: re-quote before use.
prices.confidence_meaning: builder_quoted = a builder's own published price for its standard package; stronger than an estimate, weaker than a quote for a specific build.

base_configuration.item: Base configuration: 4 VIP electric recliners (faux leather), 2-seat manual sofa with safe locker and storage, armrest meal tables, electric honeycomb curtains, Vetus electric washroom, laminated wooden flooring, insulated driver partition, 25 L fridge and kettle pantry, FRP and wood trims, concealed mood lighting, leatherette wall cushioning, factory AC rear ducting

options.item: JTAC Astro 215 roof air-conditioner with ducting
Smart automation (master control for lights, curtains, power)
Front-view camera integrated with the smart TV

priced_on_request: FRP roof carrier with back ladder
42 in LED smart TV and hands-free telecom
upgraded driver cabin trims and seating

terms.build_days: 100–110 from purchase order, advance or base vehicle, whichever is later
terms.payment: 50 % advance with the vehicle, balance on delivery; suspension upgrades 100 % advance with the vehicle
